qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Primark possesses low-cost procurement scale, but fast fashion has low customer switching costs and high substitution risk. Sugar is an unhedged cyclical commodity price-taker (operating profit swung from +£213m in FY24 to -£47m in FY26), destroying consolidated pricing power across the business cycle.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (3b = N, REJECT). Diversified UK conglomerate whose Primark retail engine is offset by commodity sugar volatility and cyclical agricultural ingredients. Primark's rock-bottom price model restricts pricing power against ultra-fast-fashion rivals, while ABF Sugar suffered a £47m operating loss in FY26 due to collapsing European sugar prices.
qualitative.evidence: Group ROACE declined to 12.7% in FY26 from 15.5% in FY25. ABF Sugar operating profit collapsed from £213m in FY24 to -£2m in FY25 and -£47m in FY26 due to European energy costs and depressed market prices. Primark generates 10-12% operating margins but lacks an e-commerce moat and faces aggressive price competition from Shein and fast-fashion discounters.
